title: Sam Darnold has message for Jets fans after winning Super Bowl 2026 with Seahawks

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sam Darnold has message for Jets fans after winning Super Bowl 2026 with Seahawks
sources.description: Sam Darnold took a moment to thank the Jets fans who have continued to support him after his career got off to an up-and-down start before he became a Super Bowl champion with the Seahawks on Sunday.
